$comment: Euclid's Elements as an rrxiv paper. The original work is in the public domain; the rrxiv encoding (claim graph, depends_on DAG, LaTeX wrapping) is released under CC-BY-4.0. v2 (Sprint 18, 2026-05-25) dogfoods RRP-0021 structured authorship: Euclid is the author, Heath is the translator we encoded, Blaise + Claude are the encoders. Previously the paper listed only the encoders, which mis-attributed two thousand years of authorship.
title: Euclid's Elements, encoded as an rrxiv paper

embedded_from.encoding_note: Every definition, postulate, common notion, and proposition is registered as an rrxiv claim or scope. Proofs use \dependson edges to make the proof DAG machine-readable. Heath's English is lightly modernised in places where 1908 prose stalls a 2026 reader.

versions.notes: Initial encoding (Sprint phase E). Mis-attributed the work to the encoders only; RRP-0021 in v2 corrects this by distinguishing roles.
